people.name: Gu Cheon
people.note: A ghost-slayer who can cross into the spirit realm since a childhood drowning.

people.name: Saeng Gang
people.note: A court lady able to hear the voices of the dead.

people.name: King
people.note: Secretly responsible for his brothers' and his own son's deaths thirty years apart.

people.name: Queen Dowager
people.note: The late king's principal consort; despises the king as lowborn.

people.name: Crown Prince Se Ja
people.note: The king's eldest son; commits suicide and returns as a vengeful ghost.

people.name: Prince Yeong An
people.note: The king's youngest son, possessed by a spirit and later killed.

people.name: Ik Sang
people.note: The king's cousin, scheming to put his own son on the throne.

people.name: Park Su
people.note: A shaman hired by Ik Sang who later serves the Crown Prince's ghost.

people.name: Prince In Ha
people.note: Ik Sang's son, later named crown prince.

people.name: Choi Suk Bin
people.note: The king's birth mother and Saeng Gang's grandmother; secretly poisoned rivals to protect her son's throne.

people.name: Royal Concubine Han
people.note: Saeng Gang's mother, a former court lady poisoned after being framed.

people.name: Ji Yul
people.note: A young court lady who becomes Saeng-gang's roommate and ally.

people.name: Favored Court Lady
people.note: A court lady of common birth, framed and killed by the Queen Dowager decades earlier.

people.name: Royal Guard
people.note: A royal guard falsely accused of an affair with the Favored Court Lady.

people.name: Gu Cheon's mother
people.note: Gu-cheon's mother, who drowned while possessed by a gwi-mae.

people.name: Chil Bok
people.note: The monk who raised Gu-cheon after his mother's death.
